div.div: Pilot light: no compute runs here. Recovery = Terraform apply into this region, restore RDS from the copied snapshots, point Active Storage at the replica bucket, and Route 53 health-check failover flips DNS. RTO is the apply + restore time; RPO is the snapshot/replication lag.

div.div:
Legend — when each line comes into play
━━ user traffic, request and response — always via CloudFront → ALB
╌╌ cluster-started egress — image pulls, packages, external APIs
╌╌ database replication
╌╌ backups and cross-region copies
╌╌ DR failover and TGW peering
╌╌ DNS, sign-in, image delivery, logs
